capabilities: Chat with a local LLM about selected notes or folders
Chunk notes and generate vector embeddings for retrieval
Summarize notes or folders, in stages if they exceed the context window
Cache embeddings on disk to speed up re-opening chats
extras: Desktop-only (runs local servers). Free and open source with a GitHub Sponsors support link shown in settings and the chat panel. Documented privacy trade-off: the optional embedding cache stores note text and vectors in unencrypted JSON and can be synced away if the .obsidian folder syncs.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to ask an LLM questions grounded in the contents of specific notes or folders, especially with a local, privacy-preserving model.
summary: RAG chat plugin that answers questions about selected notes or folders using a locally running LLM (Ollama or llama.cpp) with embedding-based retrieval.
